consequence.statement: The metric is now exported as envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration, so queries that use the old envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration name no longer match it.
consequence.remediation: Change dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration`.

decision.reason: [ev-3fa40f2e19e8] lists this metric under the 1.17 "Changed Metrics" notes as renamed to envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration. [ev-77f05428497a] says the prefix of all Envoy NPDS metrics "has been renamed" from envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_ to envoy_cilium_npds_. A rename means queries that use the old name stop matching. The evidence does not say any component fails, gets rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review), with low severity and a dashboard/alert update as the remedy, is the strict and supported reading.
